title: 1992 SkyBox DC Comics Doomsday The Death of Superman #1 Behold, The Hero! Card
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 1992 SkyBox DC Comics trading card from the "Doomsday The Death of Superman" set featuring the character Superman. The card is part of the base set and is numbered 1, titled "Behold, The Hero!" It is made of card stock and is in English language. This non-sport trading card showcases Superman in a scene from the TV show or movie "Superman," and is an original release by SkyBox in the genre of comics.
